Kin Audio
CDX-88

Cartridge disc system · Mozart × beats
Click a classical cartridge, then a beat cartridge to mix them. Grab the disc to scratch both. Slide the crossfader. Hold ◀◀ to spin back.

Music: W. A. Mozart (public domain). String Quartet No. 17 “The Hunt” K.458 I, String Quartet No. 3 K.156 I and String Quartet No. 1 K.80 I, played here as piano transcriptions.

Rendered note by note from the public-domain scores in the open-source music21 corpus, so there is no recording to license.

Piano sound: Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0.

Beats: drums and bass are synthesized live in your browser and locked to each piece’s tempo and bass line. No samples.

This piece needs WebGL, and it could not start on this device.
